quest.title: Blazin' Trails
quest.description: After drinking the spring water you found for her and recovering her voice, the fiery flower named "Blazing Heart" sends you and the others to the hall of music. The city in the mirage is strikingly similar to Liyue Harbor...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

talks.objective: Water Blazing Heart with Glacial Spring Water

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: This is the Glacial Spring Water you were looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Xinyan sprinkles the flower with spring water...

dialogues.speaker: Blazing Heart
dialogues.text: I'm feeling a lot better now. Thank you very much.

dialogues.speaker: Blazing Heart
dialogues.text: Now, I'll send you to your destination.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Argh, I'm going to lose my hat...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm? This scent... I think we've arrived at a mountain near Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But it's so dark here...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Wait, listen, there's a voice... Can you hear that?

dialogues.speaker: Mother
dialogues.text: The reason the birds sing so sweetly is because they drink the spring water from up on mountaintops. Xinyan, we're not singers in this family, none of us are. What makes you think you can be any different?

dialogues.speaker: Kid Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh, so I just need to go drink some of this spring water, and then I'll be able to sing? I'll be right back, Mama!

dialogues.speaker: Father
dialogues.text: You mustn't stay out so late in the mountains by yourself, child! You scared the bejesus out of me! ...Here, this is the spring water you were looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Kid Xinyan
dialogues.text: Really? Oh, you're the best, daddy!

dialogues.speaker: Mother
dialogues.text: Where did she run off to this time?

dialogues.speaker: Father
dialogues.text: To find somewhere she could sing, no doubt. *sigh* She can't be persuaded, and we can't stop her from walking out the door. Did you really have to lie to her like that?

dialogues.speaker: Mother
dialogues.text: How was I supposed to know she'd go running off looking for spring water! *sigh* When is she going to come to her senses...

dialogues.speaker: Man's Voice
dialogues.text: Get down from there! You can't set up a stage here! If you can't sing, you should be keeping your mouth shut, not putting on a public performance! Ugh.

dialogues.speaker: Young Xinyan
dialogues.text: Aaaah, don't tear down the stage!

talks.objective: Approach the doors from which you hear voices
Approach the doors from which you hear voices

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Zhu
dialogues.text: Xinyan, my dear child, why are you playing that crass instrument again? It's not ladylike.

dialogues.speaker: Jixiang
dialogues.text: Oh, Xinyan, your mother has asked me to teach you some embroidery when I can find the time. It's an elegant and enjoyable craft. Just come to Auntie's house whenever you're free.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Hai
dialogues.text: Quit making that racket by the side of the road! If you have to play, play something classy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—Why are they being so mean!?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ugh, these people...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ARGH! That's it! Why are you not yelling back? What happened to your rock 'n' roll spirit?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And now you're laughing!? Aren't you mad?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Sometimes it's hard to get mad when you hear the same thing a hundred times. Still... thanks, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Uh what?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Auntie Jixiang, how are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Jixiang
dialogues.text: Oh, dear child, I've been waiting to hear from you for a long time. This weekend, I'll be free...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Auntie, stop thinking about me for a hot sec, your stove is still on, and you're cooking soup, right? Hmm... you see, it's all burnt.

dialogues.speaker: Jixiang
dialogues.text: Oh! How did this happen!?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh my, Uncle Zhu, Little Zhu is playing in the mud by the river again! Didn't you tell him to not do that?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Zhu
dialogues.text: What? That rascal is up to his old shenanigans behind my back again, is he? Oh, well, we'll see about that!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Sorry, Uncle Hai, I'll move my stage someplace else. But, your musical taste needs to evolve if you wanna keep up with the times.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Maybe you didn't know, but even the most famous opera singer in Liyue likes listening to my boorish music.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Hai
dialogues.text: What did you say? Is that true? You're not making this up, are you? Huh, I'll have to look into this.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: They're all gone...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: See? Knowing the right words to say and when to smile can solve almost any problem.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: If that's the case, then what's your rock 'n' roll spirit for?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: My rock 'n' roll spirit isn't something I just use to win an argument. That'd be a real waste.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Rock 'n' roll is a revolution! Transforming your identity and destiny, saying goodbye to concessions and cowardice... it does them all. And most importantly, it lets you do it with art rather than words!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: My rock 'n' roll has an unbreakable spirit, like a flame in a rainstorm that refuses to go out, or the magma that never stops boiling under the surface of the land.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Okay, let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Let's go that way! There's a side path right there.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: *sobs* Why don't Little Meng and Little Lulu want to play with me?

talks.objective: Approach the door on the bridge

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, is that...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Another door. More delightful individuals await us on the other side, I assume?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Let me handle it. Piece of cake.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Miss, your hairstyle is really strange.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Is that so? I think it looks really cool. Take a closer look if you don't believe me.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Your hair sticks out from your head, and you wear spiky things in it... nobody else has hair like that.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: You're looking at it the wrong way. If I don't look like anybody else, once you've seen me, you won't be able to forget me even if you try. You'll still recognize me if you ever see me again in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Hmm... yeah, you're right!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Your clothes, hair, even the way you walk and talk... It's not just for the eyes of others. It's your style, so you should go with whatever you like.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Really? But if I wore a jacket with a picture of a puppy on it, people would say, "Hey, Little Fei likes stupid little puppies."

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Then you should ignore them. So, you like puppies, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: I do.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: What about your friends?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Well... yeah, they do too.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Well then, your friends are gonna love that jacket.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: ...'Kay. Miss, how come you don't do your hair in a nice braid? People would love that.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I can't help myself, I just like the styles with personality. *sigh* Plus I had no idea how so many people would dislike it before I started wearing my hair like this.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: So why don't you change it now?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Well, this hairstyle suits my music and my lifestyle. The regular ones are boring, they're so uninspired. Plus they get in the way when I'm head-bobbing away on stage.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: If people don't like it, that's up to them. I ain't gonna change it.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: What about your friends? Do they not like it, too?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Course they like it! They all say that they think it looks amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: ...Your friends are nice to you. That's cool. Not like my friends... they left me here on my own. *sobs*

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hey now, why are you crying? What's wrong? You can talk to me.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Little Lulu and Little Meng... they're ignoring me... *sobs* We were gonna meet at the docks today, but they still haven't shown up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These kids are way too young to be standing each other up like this!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Stay right here, I'll go take a look around. I'll bring them to you once I find them.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: O—Okay! Thanks, Miss. I'll never say anything bad about your hair again.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: See, now you're talkin' sense! I'll see you later.

talks.objective: Help Little Fei to look for his friends

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Excuse me, are you Little Meng? Little Fei is waiting for you at the docks. He's been waiting so long now that he's in tears about it.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Ugh! Why is he so dumb, he could have just come here and found us... Never mind, I'll go find him instead.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He ran off. We should catch up to him.

talks.objective: Help Little Fei to look for his friends

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Excuse me, are you Little Lulu?

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Are you looking for me, Miss?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Didn't you promise to meet Little Fei at the docks? Why aren't you going to meet up with him? He's crying 'cause he thinks you've abandoned him.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Huh? That silly dumb-dumb, why didn't he just come to look for us? We prepared a surprise gift for him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A surprise gift? How strange...

talks.objective: Talk to Little Fei, Little Meng, and Little Lulu

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: You dumb-dumb, we were preparing a surprise gift for you! We didn't think that you wouldn't come to try and find us... and definitely didn't think you'd start crying about it...

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: I'm sorry for being such an idiot...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: No, I'm sorry! You're not an idiot. I guess we shouldn't have been so secretive about it.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: We didn't come to the docks to meet you because we wanted to give you a big surprise for your birthday.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Huh? This is...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: We've brought you loads of yummy Lotus Heads. And here's a handwritten birthday letter from me and Lulu, too... please don't call our handwriting ugly, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Tee-hee!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: You guys... Hehe, thank you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... and all's well that ends well!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It was all just a misunderstanding.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Well, sometimes that's just what friends do. If my friends had ditched me to plan a surprise, I'd have gotten upset too.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Is that a hint for us to prepare a surprise for you, too? Very clever...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: No! I was just speaking my mind...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hehe, I know. I was just joking... seeing if I could give you a fright.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... everyone... Paimon's hungry...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That rumble had no business being that loud!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: It's almost lunchtime, so how about... we have lunch at my house? It's not far from here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So even your house is in this mirage?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Yep. I just noticed, there's the same road in here as the one that leads to my house in real life.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Even though we're in a mirage, I reckon some things will always remain the same. In real life, after a bad quarrel with the neighbors, or a disappointing show...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: The one place I'll always go is my house. Because... everyone has to go home eventually.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Here we are. Please come in! Make yourselves at home, no need to take off your shoes!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Thank you for your hospitality.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Oh, chairs! We can finally unwind for a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Huh? Did you guys hear a sound coming from the other room...? You all keep resting here, I'll go have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: The lights aren't even on, and there's no one— woah!!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling and Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Dun dun DUN!!! Happy Birthday!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: What are you two doing? Why are you sitting in the dark inside my house? You scared the bejesus outta me!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Yun Jin, you were totally right. She does get spooked!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: It's your birthday, so we planned a surprise party for you.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: You girls really shouldn't pull these pranks while pretending to be all sweet and innocent...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Eh? Come on now, what's wrong with that? Who says that being cute and innocent means you can't pull pranks? Back me up, Xiangling?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Totally, Yun Jin! Guoba pulls pranks on me all the time, too.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, you win.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Beidou needs to do something today, so she's asked me to bring some gifts along from her, for you.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: So here they are! A custom-made dagger, and the score of a composition from abroad!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: As for my offerings, I had these gold hairpins and iron hair ties custom-made for you by my family.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Iron hair ties!? You're telling me that your family used their one thousand years' worth of experience to make... hair ties?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: What's the problem? Hair ties may look simple and unassuming, but they actually require a lot of intricate craftsmanship to make!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hehe, my gift is one-of-a-kind. A little while ago, I came across a bespectacled blacksmith on the street. The way he worked and talked, it felt almost like he could see right through stones.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I was skeptical, so I asked him to help me make a bet, and when the merchant cracked the stone open, there was indeed a piece of raw jade inside! Hehe, I took the jade on the spot and ground it into a pendant, which I then strung on a cord. You can use it as an accessory.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Wow, you made a jade pendant for me?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Yeah! Oh, don't wear it around your neck! Put it on your guitar! Every day, I see how much you pamper that guitar, so I thought you should jazz it up a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I don't know if I can bring myself to hang this thing anywhere except in a display case on an altar! Thank you, Xiangling. You're so thoughtful.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Hehe, Xiangling has always been thoughtful. But the blacksmith you mentioned who could see through stones... can you tell me more about him? If the story's interesting enough, I might have to put it into my play.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I'm not exactly sure, but I hear that he was sick for a while, and was so disoriented during that time that he couldn't remember anything, and felt as if his body didn't belong to him...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: And then, all of a sudden, he recovered! He's all fine now, except for some reason, he can now tell the difference between valuable and worthless stones just by looking at them.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Hmm... that's certainly peculiar.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Let's not get into that. The food is getting cold. Let's eat!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Wait, Xinyan, didn't you pick up a trick from an outlander merchant? The one you taught me on my last birthday.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, you mean making a birthday wish?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Yes, that's the one. They also light candles and cut cakes in other regions, but we didn't have time for that, because we were too busy bringing the food over.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: It's fine, I can just use my imagination.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Okay, let's count to three and you can make a wish.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: One...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Two...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Three...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hmm, what should I wish for this year...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: My wish is...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm back?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What happened? Paimon was just peering through the crack in the door.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Given that we are in a mirage, Xinyan, did anything significant happen inside the house?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon knows, Paimon knows, she ran into some of her friends who were throwing her a birthday party!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Yes, I heard all that! I mean something she did herself.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: ...Oh! I made a wish.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: It's pretty interesting, now that I think about it. When I entered the room, I found Xiangling and Yun Jin, two of my best friends!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: That actually happened in real life. They paid me a surprise visit on my birthday, set a table with delicious food, and persuaded me to make a birthday wish.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: My wish was to "perform with someone completely unexpected."

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Hmm, I wonder who this unexpected person might be?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Oh, you already know the answer?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Mm-hmm. However, before I tell you the answer, I'd like to clear the water veins that flow through the mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: What a great mindset you have. If anyone ever called me anything less than a genius, I'd be furious.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Paimon is tempted to give it a shot... Eeek! Mona is glaring at me!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Paimon, there's a difference between embracing the spirit of rock 'n' roll and playing with fire...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: To tell you the truth, I'm also starting to develop an interest in rock 'n' roll.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Seriously? This'd better not be a joke.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: No, I'm serious. Rock 'n' roll's ability to cultivate such a strong will in people is an incredible thing.
